scheme_name: Scheme for Giving Financial Assistance to the Legal Heirs of the Deceased Artist (Wife/Husband) on the Death of the Indigent Artist Who Was Receiving Financial Assistance
other_conditions: Applicant must be the legal heir (wife/husband) of the deceased artist.
Deceased must have been an artist and receiving assistance under the Scheme of Financial Assistance to Indigent Artistes.
Deceased must have been at least 58 years old at the time of death.
Deceased must have professionally served in any art discipline such as music, dance, drama, film, folk arts, etc.
Annual income of the deceased artist or their legal spouse must not exceed ₹12,000.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹3,000 per month to the eligible legal heir (wife/husband).
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attest, if required)
